Scroll to 高等教育の修学支援新制度について.

reusable_rules: Search tuition or scholarship pages for 高等教育の修学支援新制度 when no separate 情報公開 page appears.

Do not accept a 2025 filename as FY2026 even when the page is currently linked.

evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-11 found the support-system anchor on the tuition page and verified the 2025 PDF body contains 日本大学歯学部附属歯科衛生専門学校 and 様式第２号.
